integrity: Two explicitly constructed 512-term integral cycles and an identity coordinate evaluation establish a primitive integral basis after an exhaustive mod-two rank upper bound.
scientific_limitations: Only circumferences 3 through 6 and third integral homology are proved; no infinite-family extrapolation, lower-degree groups, or ring structure. Exact code is an auditable finite certificate, not independent audit.
title: First integral third homology in three-particle circular-prism configurations
